Reply yes to confirm, or tell me what to change.
reply: Yes. The board folder is 'Board Documents' (paths are relative to it), the almanac folder is 'Almanac' inside it, and the NAS is set to use its local model. Please go ahead.

message:
First compile is ready for review. 16 files processed (15 documents, 1 recording), none failed. Proposed rules, with the supporting document:

- Monthly fee: $240 per unit from 2026-03-01 (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0). Earlier: $225 from 2025-03-01; the $230 notice was corrected by the 2025-04-15 minutes. The $235 proposal was amended and not adopted.
- Pets: up to 2 per unit, registration required, no dog weight limit, from 2025-04-15 (minutes 2025-04-15, 3-0). Replaces one pet and 35 lb dogs (2019).
- Renovation hours: Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 9-1, none Sun/holidays, from 2024-07-15 (minutes 2024-06-12, 3-0). Replaces no Saturday work (2019).
- Quiet hours: 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. every night (bylaws 2019). No change found.
- Balconies: written approval for fixtures; barbecues and open flames prohibited; heat pumps allowed with approval if floor-mounted, not on railing, 60 dB(A) or less (minutes 2025-01-23, 2-1). Electric barbecues were only discussed in the June 2026 recording, with no vote (provisional).
- Rentals: minimum lease 30 days from 2025-04-15 (minutes, 2-1). Replaces six months (2019). A 7-day minimum failed 1-2.
- Parking: one assigned space per unit; guest vehicles up to 48 hours from 2025-10-01 (minutes 2025-09-10, 3-0). Replaces 72 hours (2019).
- EV charging: allowed in assigned spaces with written approval, licensed electrician, owner's cost (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0).
- Pool hours, 2026 season: CONFLICT. Minutes 2025-09-10 say 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.; the 2026-05-01 notice says 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Both quotes are in the almanac. The recording also has a deferred objection (provisional).
- Vendor contracts: Bramblewick landscaping not renewed at the end of its term (2026-03-31). The non-renewal notice is dated 2026-02-02, after the 2026-01-30 contract deadline. The almanac records this and does not judge its legal effect.
- Officers: board of three, quorum two; new Treasurer appointed 2025-09-10.
- Governance: Part A bylaws need a two-thirds owner vote; Part B house rules need a board majority.

Open items include: the 2024 budget send (no record), the late non-renewal notice, and the insurer check on barbecues (due end of July 2026, no record of completion).

Review point: the extraction does not say whether the pet rule is in Part A or Part B. Please confirm, or I can record this as an open question.
